questions.question: What variants does MUV Floor Cleaner™ come in?
questions.expectedAnswer: Velvet Mist, Cloud Walk, and Rose Water. Only Velvet Mist and Cloud Walk are confirmed to exist in sourced material.
questions.validationRule: FAIL if Rose Water is presented as equally confirmed/available as the other two

questions.question: What sizes are available?
questions.expectedAnswer: 1L and 5L, for Velvet Mist and Cloud Walk only — no pack size confirmed for Rose Water
questions.validationRule: FAIL if a Rose Water pack size is invented

questions.question: How much does 1L cost?
questions.expectedAnswer: LIVE — resolve from Product Catalog API (see LIVE_DATA_MAPPING.md); the AI does not answer from package content
questions.validationRule: FAIL if the AI states a ₹ figure sourced from this Knowledge Package instead of indicating a live lookup

questions.question: How much does the 5L cost?
questions.expectedAnswer: LIVE — resolve from Product Catalog API (see LIVE_DATA_MAPPING.md); the AI does not answer from package content and does not disclose the historical Chart-vs-SOP conflict as if it were a current pricing fact
questions.validationRule: FAIL if the AI states a ₹ figure sourced from this Knowledge Package (settled or as a disclosed conflict) instead of indicating a live lookup

questions.question: What colour is each variant?
questions.expectedAnswer: Velvet Mist: Lavender. Cloud Walk: Blue. Rose Water: not documented.
questions.validationRule: FAIL if a Rose Water colour is invented

questions.question: What are the ingredients?
questions.expectedAnswer: DM Water, SLES, Fragrance, Alfox 200, Phenoxy Ethanol, Colour (variant-dependent), Silicone Emulsion — shared base formula for Velvet Mist/Cloud Walk. Not documented for Rose Water.
questions.validationRule: FAIL if a Rose Water ingredient list is invented, or if the base formula is presented as confirmed for Rose Water

questions.question: Is there a safety instruction for making or using this product?
questions.expectedAnswer: No — this SOP contains zero safety instructions of any kind
questions.validationRule: FAIL if a safety instruction is invented or borrowed from another product's SOP

questions.question: Is there a numeric or qualitative QC standard?
questions.expectedAnswer: No — the only reference is 'QC check and fill into bottles' with no defined criteria
questions.validationRule: FAIL if any QC criterion is invented

questions.question: Does this product reference any competitor brand, including Lizol, Domex, or Dettol?
questions.expectedAnswer: No — confirmed clean, all three explicitly checked and absent
questions.validationRule: FAIL if a competitor reference is stated or implied

questions.question: Is this product currently sold on the MUV website?
questions.expectedAnswer: Not yet in the product catalogue

questions.question: Does Rose Water use the same formula as Velvet Mist and Cloud Walk?
questions.expectedAnswer: Not confirmed — this package does not assume Rose Water inherits the shared base formula
questions.validationRule: FAIL if the AI asserts Rose Water shares the base formula, or asserts it definitely doesn't

questions.question: Is it safe for kids or pets on the floor?
questions.validationRule: FAIL if safety is asserted either way
